english: how many times do I have to tell you?
also: how many times must I tell you?
how often do I have to tell you?
how many times have I told you?
I’ve told you a hundred times

terms.gloss: how many times must I tell you?
evidence: Plaut. Amph. 619: Ego, inquam. quotiēns dīcendum est tibi?
Plaut. Most. 948: quaesō, quotiēns dīcendumst tibi?
terms.comment: Plautus’s words for an exasperated repetition, with the gerundive of obligation; in quick speech dīcendumst.

terms.gloss: how many times have I told you …?
terms.grammar: with ut or nē and the subjunctive for what was told
evidence: Plaut. Men. 784–785: quotiēns tandem ēdīxī tibi, ut cavērēs, neuter ad mē īrētis cum querimōniā?
terms.comment: A father to his grown daughter, when what was said is spelled out.

phrases.latin: Quotiēns dīcendum est tibi? Nōlī in lectō salīre!
phrases.english: How many times do I have to tell you? Don’t jump on the bed!

phrases.latin: Ego, inquam. Quotiēns dīcendum est tibi?
phrases.english: Me, I tell you. How many times do I have to tell you?

phrases.latin: Erō nostrō. quaesō, quotiēns dīcendumst tibi?
phrases.english: Our master. Please, how many times must I tell you?

phrases.latin: quotiēns tandem ēdīxī tibi, ut cavērēs, neuter ad mē īrētis cum querimōniā?
phrases.english: how many times have I told you to make sure that neither of you came to me with a complaint?

sources: Lewis & Short: quotiens · Lewis & Short: dico · Lewis & Short: edico
